page_note: 这是一张幻灯片式报告页，标题为"Holding Period and Value"，页面主体是一幅三条折线的图，比较$100投资在不同持有年限下的未来价值（股票、长期国债、短期国库券）。

components.evidence: "Stocks ($)", "Treasury Bonds ($)", "Treasury Bills ($)" stacked in a column at the right of the plot
horizontal rules at 500-intervals across the panel, no vertical rules
y axis reads bare 0..4500; scale word only in axis title "Future value of $100 investment"
"Future value of $100 investment" set vertically alongside the left value axis

new_components.name: category_axis_title_below_plot
new_components.evidence: "Holding period (in years)" printed in bold under the x tick row
new_components.why_it_matters: 类别轴的含义（年限）只写在图下方一行，表格若不带这行就无法说明列头"1,5,10..."是年数。

new_components.name: numeric_categorical_x_axis
new_components.evidence: x ticks 1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40 drawn at equal spacing though intervals differ
new_components.why_it_matters: 横轴数值间距不等但等距绘制，不能按线性内插定位点，只能逐个类别读取。

new_components.name: marker_shape_per_series
new_components.evidence: square markers on Stocks, star markers on Treasury Bonds, x markers on Treasury Bills, repeated in legend
new_components.why_it_matters: 三线在低值区几乎重叠，只能靠标记形状区分是哪条序列的点。

difficulty_notes: 最大的障碍是读数精度：值轴每500一格（约52像素），而待核的九个值里有六个小于700，全挤在最低那一格半之内。240的5%容差只有±12，相当于1.2像素；250与280之间只差3像素，三条线在1–20年区间几乎重叠，连区分是Treasury Bonds ($)还是Treasury Bills ($)都要靠标记形状。图上没有任何数值标签，也没有Source行，全部数字必须靠像素对齐横向网格线推算，这比标签寻址（每个值只需序列名+年限两个键）困难得多。
